Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1255163. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, activities to assays on assay_id, and assays to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL1255163, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and pChEMBL value not null. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows without deduplication.
